Name: Ace's Building Tilesheets (Content Patcher)
Author: acerbicon
Description:
[center][b]Ace's Building Tilesheets [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b](Content Patcher)[/b][/url][/center][center]﻿
Do you hate having to deal with overwriting even custom tilesheets? Do you
really want to edit the tilesheets to your own liking anytime you want without
having to go through the pain of unpacking and repacking messy .xnb files?
Well, your prayers have been answered. Now you can simply download this
mod to use with all the building mods from acerbicon you're already using.
They won't work without this now and because all the buildings use them
it has to be it's own separate mod! Enjoy~!

[size=2][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]:[/size][size=2] 
[url=http://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[/size][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1140/?]
[/url][/size]
[b][size=2]HOW TO INSTALL:[/size]
[/b]1[size=2]. Download mod.
2. Unzip file into "Mods" folder.[/size][/center]

Downloads.Description:
The tilesheets that are necessary to use my expanded Houses, Cabins, Sheds, and/or Cellars

Now includes options to match these to the various town/house tilesheet recolors available on Nexus. Vibrant Pastoral now added.

Manifest.Name: Ace Buildings Expanded Tilesheets
Manifest.Description: Loads the Tilesheets for all of my building mods
